Binance will record each user’s confirmed BTCY holdings daily at 00:00 (UTC) during the Promotion Period.
Daily eligible holdings will be calculated as follows:
If a user’s BTCY holdings are below 0.01 BTCY on a given day, the eligible holdings for that day will be zero.
If a user’s BTCY holdings are equal to or greater than 0.01 BTCY, the actual holdings will be counted, subject to a maximum of 20 BTCY per day.
The average eligible holdings during the Promotion Period will be calculated as follows:
Daily Average Eligible Holdings = Sum of Daily Eligible Holdings for All 30 Reward Calculation Days / 30

Regular User APR Boost Reward for existing holdings: Reward = (Daily Average Eligible Holdings × 0.25% × 30) / 365.

APR Rewards:

This 25% Special APR is offered as an additional reward on top of Real-Time APR. This is calculated based on the subscribed amounts up to the cap of 500 USDC for this campaign. Upon subscription, the 25% Special APR rewards start to accrue the next day starting from 00:00 (UTC) based on the snapshot of the user’s subscribed amount to the Flexible Products of the day. This snapshot will be taken randomly between 00:00:00 to 23:59:59 (UTC) daily. Rewards will start to be distributed the following day after accrual starts between 00:00 (UTC) and 08:00 (UTC) to the user’s Spot Account.
Any redemption of Flexible Products made between 00:00:00 (UTC) and 00:00:00 (UTC) of the following day will stop the accrual of Special Tiered APR rewards on the redeemed amount for that day.
This 25% Special APR reward is calculated based on the subscribed amounts and is subject to the respective tier limit for each token. Please refer to this FAQ for more details.
